blocks.text: On the Share Files Externally Settings page, (Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint Data Scan > Sensitive Information > Share Files Externally > Settings), you can configure the domain and assign users who are permitted to share files externally.
To configure a domain and assign users:

blocks.item: 1. Add Domains.
On the Domains tab, click Add Domains.
The Add Domains drawer appears.
Select from one of the following options:
None: To prevent files from being shared with any external domains.
Specific Domains: To restrict file sharing to a predefined list of authorized domains.
Any Domain: To allow all files to be shared with all external domains without restriction.
See image.
Click Update.
The domain is listed in the table.
2. Assign Users.
On the Users tab, click Assign Users.
The Assign User drawer appears.
Select from one of the following options:
None: To prevent all internal users from sharing files externally.
Specific Users: To grant external file sharing permission only to a defined list of users, groups, or departments.
Any User: To allow all files to be shared within your organization to share files externally.
See image.
Click Update.
The user is listed in the table.

blocks.text: To enable the changes, you must activate the change. You can edit or delete any template or user that you added.
